summary_ja: ファンド等の出資の性質を有する保有エクスポージャーのリスク・ウェイトを直接判定できない場合に、ルックスルー方式（第三者判定は一・二倍）、マンデート方式、蓋然性方式（二百五十・四百パーセント）、フォールバック方式（千二百五十パーセント）の順で算出し、レバレッジ調整を行うことを定める。
summary_en: Equity investments in funds whose risk weight can't be set directly: look-through (third-party calculations ×1.2), mandate-based approach, probability approach (250%/400%), or fallback 1,250%, with a leverage adjustment capped at 1,250%.

terms.ja: 保有エクスポージャー

paragraphs: Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach cannot directly determine the risk weight of an exposure it holds (limited to one having the nature of an investment; referred to as a "held exposure" in this Article, Article 126, paragraph (8) and Article 144), it shall calculate that risk weight as provided in this Article.

Where the information on the exposures of the individual assets and transactions underlying a held exposure (referred to as the "underlying assets, etc." in this Article, Article 126, paragraph (7) and Article 144) satisfies all of the following requirements, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall use as the risk weight of the held exposure the ratio obtained by dividing the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. by the total assets of the company, partnership or other similar entity that actually holds the underlying assets, etc. (collectively referred to as "entities" in this Article and Article 144). (i) That it is obtained by the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach sufficiently and frequently. (ii) That it is verified by an independent third party.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, in calculating the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, the provisions of Article 14 shall apply mutatis mutandis, deeming the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach to be a person directly holding the underlying assets, etc. In this case, the term "the sum of the following amounts" in that Article shall be read as "the sum of the following amounts (excluding the amount listed in item (iii))", and the term "credit equivalent amounts" in item (i) of that Article shall be read as "credit equivalent amounts (where those derivative transactions include derivative transactions whose counterparties are persons other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amounts of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying the credit equivalent amount of those derivative transactions by 1.5, and the credit equivalent amounts of other derivative transactions and of long settlement period transactions)".

Where, in the case of paragraph (2), an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach has tried to calculate the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure but cannot satisfy only the requirement listed in item (i) of that paragraph, and the information on the exposures of the underlying assets, etc. is obtained by a third party sufficiently and frequently, it may use the risk weights determined by that third party for those exposures.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, in calculating the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure using the risk weights determined by the third party under that paragraph, the provisions of Article 14 shall apply mutatis mutandis, deeming that third party to be an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach directly holding the underlying assets, etc. In this case, the term "means the sum of the following amounts" in that Article shall be read as "means the sum of the following amounts (excluding the amount listed in item (iii)), and in calculating that sum, the risk weights applied to the individual assets and transactions shall be adjusted by multiplying them by 1.2", the term "that Section" shall be read as "that Section, using as the risk weight the value obtained by multiplying that risk weight by 1.2", and the term "credit equivalent amounts" in item (i) of that Article shall be read as "credit equivalent amounts (where those derivative transactions include derivative transactions whose counterparties are persons other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amounts of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying the credit equivalent amount of those derivative transactions by 1.5, and the credit equivalent amounts of other derivative transactions and of long settlement period transactions)".

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach cannot satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2), and the standards for managing the underlying assets, etc. (referred to as the "investment mandate" in this Article and Article 144) are clearly stated, it may use as the risk weight of the held exposure the ratio obtained by dividing the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of the held exposure, calculated to be the maximum under the investment mandate, by the total assets of the entity that actually holds the underlying assets, etc.

In the case of the preceding paragraph, in calculating the total credit risk-weighted assets of the underlying assets, etc. of a held exposure, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall assume the composition of underlying assets, etc. that maximizes the total credit risk-weighted assets under the investment mandate in that paragraph, and the provisions of Article 14 shall apply mutatis mutandis, deeming the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach to be a person directly holding the underlying assets, etc. of that composition. In this case, the term "the sum of the following amounts" in that Article shall be read as "the sum of the following amounts (excluding the amount listed in item (iii))", and the term "credit equivalent amounts" in item (i) of that Article shall be read as "credit equivalent amounts (where those derivative transactions include derivative transactions whose counterparties are persons other than those listed in the items of Article 248-2, paragraph (2), the credit equivalent amounts of off-balance sheet transactions, the amount obtained by multiplying the credit equivalent amount of those derivative transactions by 1.5, and the credit equivalent amounts of other derivative transactions and of long settlement period transactions)".

When an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach calculates the risk weight of a held exposure under the provisions of paragraph (2) or paragraph (6), it shall calculate the risk weight by adjusting the risk weight listed in each of the following items by multiplying it by the value specified in that item; provided, however, that where the risk weight obtained as a result of the adjustment exceeds 1,250%, it shall be 1,250%. (i) The risk weight of paragraph (2): the value obtained by dividing the total assets of the entity by its net assets. (ii) The risk weight of paragraph (6): the maximum value specified in the preceding item permitted under the investment mandate.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach cannot satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2) and cannot apply paragraph (6), and has shown that the risk weight of the held exposure is highly likely to be the ratio listed in either of the following items, it may use the ratio specified in that item as the risk weight. (i) 250% or less: 250%. (ii) More than 250% and 400% or less: 400%.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach cannot satisfy the requirements listed in the items of paragraph (2) and cannot apply paragraph (6) or the preceding paragraph, it shall use a risk weight of 1,250% for the held exposure.
